dct_description_sm: The purpose of this multi-year project was to complete, in the first year, the following objectives: (1) Improve the understanding of climate change impacts on the Eeyou Istchee community in James Bay, using both traditional/local Cree knowledge and scientific information; (2) improve the understanding of human implications of climate change for Eeyou Istchee, focusing on the impacts on hunters, trappers, and other community members; (3) identify the vulnerabilities of Eeyou Istchee to climate change, as well as mitigation and adaptation strategies, (4) incorporate Cree accounts, observations, concerns and priorities in adaptation strategies, and (5) develop tools, community consultation processes and guidance documents that will help mitigate climate change impacts in Eeyou Istchee.  In its second year, the project aimed: - To continue to improve the understanding and awareness of implications of climate change on Eeyou Istchee; - To continue assessing impacts in selected Cree societies; - To study the changes and vulnerabilities in traditional subsistence activities, land use, and society; and - To identify and prioritize adaptation actions within the selected communities by creating an information base, or GeoPortal, which is a tool to collect and distribute traditional, local, geospatial, and scientific knowledge.

dct_title_s: Identification of Climate Change Impacts and Adaptation Measures for the Hunters, Trappers, and Communities of Eeyou Istchee
